dataset: India government jobs — official portal snapshot
description: A dated, curated snapshot of active India government-job notices found on primary official portals. It is not an exhaustive guarantee of every vacancy on the internet; applicants should confirm the complete advertisement, eligibility, dates and application process at the official source before applying.
coverageNote: Official-source coverage only. This snapshot includes four open notices from ISRO / the Department of Space and the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), checked on 14 Nov 2026, plus selected official discovery hubs; it does not claim complete coverage of all central, state or public-sector vacancies.
sourceHubNote: Some official portals require JavaScript or do not expose a structured feed in this static snapshot. The hub links are provided for direct checking and broader discovery.
classificationNote: Rank and category are WILSY display and browsing fields, not official merit lists, appointment grades or vacancy counts.

sourceHubs.name: National Career Service — government jobs
sourceHubs.note: Official government-job search hub; the portal may require JavaScript and has no structured feed exposed to this static snapshot.

sourceHubs.note: Official ISRO current-opportunities hub, covering ISRO centres and the Department of Space; it is the discovery source for the ISRO and DOS notices in this snapshot.

sourceHubs.note: Official Bhabha Atomic Research Centre page for current advertisements and walk-in interviews; the discovery source for the BARC notices in this snapshot.

jobs.title: Group-A and Group-B posts (deputation)
jobs.ministryDepartment: Department of Space, Government of India
jobs.gradeLevel: Pay Level 7–13 · Group-A officer, stenographic and official-language posts; Group-B clerical and stenographic posts
jobs.salaryPayBand: Pay Levels 7–13 (7th CPC), by post; verify each post in the official notice.
jobs.experienceEligibility: Deputation only: open to serving officials of ISRO and central government services holding analogous or qualifying posts, forwarded through their department. Not open to fresh applicants. Includes 17 Assistant Section Officer posts (Level 7) and 6 stenographic posts (Level 8).
jobs.verificationNote: Official ISRO careers page lists this Department of Space notice as Open, dated 15 Oct 2026. The office memorandum of 6 Nov 2026 extends the last date for receipt of applications to 30 Nov 2026. Checked 12 Nov 2026; confirm each post’s pay level and eligibility in the advertisement.

jobs.title: Medical Officer (Pathology), walk-in interview
jobs.ministryDepartment: Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India
jobs.gradeLevel: Medical Officer at SO/D emoluments · ad hoc / locum leave vacancy
jobs.salaryPayBand: Consolidated ₹45,098 per month plus DA, about ₹1,20,000 in hand per month (approx., per the notice).
jobs.experienceEligibility: MD / DNB in Pathology from a recognised university; age not more than 50 on the interview date. One post, 178 days and not more than 89 days at a time.
jobs.verificationNote: BARC’s official new-vacancies page (last updated 6 Nov 2026) lists this walk-in interview for Monday 23 Nov 2026 at 10.30 am, with reporting at 8.30 am at BARC Hospital, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai. Checked 12 Nov 2026; bring the application format and certificates listed in the notice.
